content: --- name: video-editor description: "Read first for Manus Desktop video creation, editing, inspection, or export." --- # Video Editor Keep requirements/plan/editor choice. Deliver standalone clips directly; [Editor](#editor): composition/timing/subtitles/audio/MG/editable projects; existing-project inspection/edits/export. ## Core requirements **Consistency, a compelling video, and fidelity to the user's request must all hold.** - Consistency: approved people/products, shared settings/light/style, reused character voices. - Viewing: clear composition/light/materials, purposeful action/camera, pacing/sound advancing action/information at normal speed. - Intent: content/story/product facts/style/platform/deliverables, specified actions/lines, quiet atmosphere, locked cameras. Model instructions: English. Specified dialogue/visible text: verbatim, requested language. ## User Intent Understand message/assets/references; confirm **ratio/approximate duration** before canvas/shot timing/dependent generation. Meanwhile analyze/search/research/draft; batch missing questions. Reuse known info/project settings; clarify changes only. Allow duration variation for completeness/clarity/natural pacing; narration need not fill the video. No duration-driven filler, narration redo, repeated/prolonged visuals, loops, speed changes, or loss of necessary information. ## Creative Workflow Editable brief plan (standalone clips: in prompt); resume revisions at their stage: 1. Intent: above, deliverables/audience/platform. 2. Idea/style: message/emotion/visual direction. 3. Shots: plan whole video; usually 2–3s cuts, faster for energetic feeds; allow speech/full actions/readable details/stillness. Per shot: starting view, action/result, camera direction/path/pace, ending framing/sound/cut; record continuity joins. Social hook: information/movement/sound in first 2s. 4. Assets: reuse media; references below; needed setting/style images, sound/native MG. 5. Production: follow generation limits; precise Editor composition/arrangement. 6. Check/deliver: QA below, adjust, deliver agreed files/project. Narrative shorts: resolve one theme, 1–2 people/few locations; dialogue/action/production sound, light voice-over. Brands can be plot-driving objects. Honor silent-film/mood/narration-led requests. ## Creative Methods Choose a workflow's relevant stage/sections for narrative/style/presentation; ordinary re-edits need none. Parallel independent reads; reuse material. - [Ads/ecommerce/conversion](workflows/marketing-growth.md) - [Product launches/features](workflows/product-launch.md) - [Explainers/documentaries/essays](workflows/narration-led.md) - [Talking heads/interviews/portrait reframing](workflows/talking-head.md) - [Podcast/live/long-video excerpts](workflows/long-to-short.md) - [Course slides/training/academic talks](workflows/slides-to-video.md) - [AI UGC/testimonials/recommendations](workflows/ugc-video.md) - [Primarily motion graphics](workflows/motion-graphics.md) - [Narrative shorts: current stage](workflows/creative-shorts/README.md) ## Generate missing assets Schemas: model IDs/duration/references/audio/output. Image/audio-only: deliver files directly; name/deliver audio tracks separately. ### References and images Crop/format: image processing; SVG: drawing tools. Reuse approved/supplied assets. People/products: approved refs. New character: generate/approve a master, then image-to-image close-ups/angles/costumes from it; prefer a main/detail sheet. Exact logos/products/webpages/UI: supplied/official/approved designs. References: identity/clothes, space/materials/light, product appearance/structure; shots: pose/action. Use text for settings/light/style; images only for concrete needs. Stills/masters: `gpt-image-2.5` 1080p; creative-shorts realistic-human masters/face derivatives: Nano Banana 2.1 (`nano-banana-2.1`), 2K. If unavailable, explain options. Preserve unedited areas. Prompt: purpose/subject/appearance/material/scene/light/composition/style/preservation. Check identity/product shape/marks/ratio/text/real transparency; fix material issues together; deliver when usable. ### Video If available: MiniMax/H3 for speed/cost, Seedance 2.5 for quality (2.0 optional). People/products: references-to-video; no default first/last frames. One multi-shot request; split only for duration/reference/capability limits or requested independent clips. `Shot 1`, `Shot 2`, natural-language pacing; total duration in parameters. Default 720p, requested 1080p, no 4K. Submit shot action/camera/style/sound and real reference roles/attachments. Audible Seedance: audio on; specify ambience/action SFX sources/actions/timing for synchronized generation. Retain audio under separate BGM; music cannot replace SFX. Preserve dialogue/lip sync. Multi-call log: unit IDs/references/outputs/durations/audio/joins. ### Speech Separate spoken-language text from language/accent/pace/context/voice instructions. Reuse voice references; label each line's speaker. Natural punctuation for pauses; supported tags only. Split sentences/thoughts only for independent timing; otherwise complete/accurate/natural passages. Reuse narration/word times; measure/audition before dependent visuals. New timbre: audition/reuse one clean, music-free, single-speaker 4–6s sample if supported. Check lines/pronunciation/language/phrasing/file usability. ### Music and effects Specify duration/mood arc/style/tempo/instruments/density/space/opening-development-ending; `Instrumental only, no vocals` when vocal-free. One request within limits; keep rhythm/timbre/joins continuous across sections. Narration: spacious music, steady dynamics, below voice; retain dialogue/ambience/action SFX. Separate SFX: existing footage, audio-only, or models lacking synchronized audio. Describe source/action/material/distance/space/duration(single/continuous)/onset/tail; align to visible events. One action/effect, clean onset/full tail, only target source per isolated track. Ambience: continuous space, explicit loop purpose, checked seams. Audition source/quality/duration/tail; music: style/vocal requirements/ending; SFX: action clarity/space. Final mix: audible/synchronized/unmasked action sounds. Examples: relevant [asset templates](workflows/creative-shorts/02-asset-design.md) or [video prompts](capabilities/model-video-generation.md) sections. ## Editor module ### Enter and Import `mcp`: `server:"video-editor"`, bare tool names. Get missing schemas before first call; reuse loaded ones. Desktop provides Electron/FFmpeg; no dependency preflight/downloads. 1. Project: first message: reuse Host context/`get_status.activeProject`; else `manage_projects(operation:"open")`, then `get_timeline`. Preserve content/settings. 2. Import first: reuse `get_media(operation:"list")`; await batch-import of missing user media before analysis/production. Read documents/spreadsheets in working directory; no media, skip import. 3. Canvas: create: `manage_projects(operation:"open",initialCanvas:{width,height,fps?})`. Target: `edit_timeline` + `timelineId`, `set_canvas` with ≥1 `width`/`height`/`backgroundColor`; omitted fields unchanged. `get_timeline`: dimensions/background. Main only, regardless of UI tab: `editor_update_project({canvas:{width,height,fps?}})` does not display the Editor or add a Resource card; `manage_projects(operation:"open",canvas:...)` displays Editor. Set fps before items; new timeline fps via `create_timeline`. `import_media(source:{kind:"local",paths:[...]})`: persistent real absolute Host paths. Poll same args only while `in_progress`; completed `items[].mediaId`; resolve errors. Import intact originals/timebases; no FFmpeg presplitting; select source ranges. Revisions: new filename → import → replace affected clips preserving timing; reimport alone changes no clips. [Import details](capabilities/media-import-details.md): paths/source links/batch budgets. ### Basic Editing Common ops below; batch-read `references/edit-timeline/.schema.json` for others/extra fields. - `operations` OR `inputFile`: ≤64 ordered atomic operations; `dryRun` validates, no save. - Code-generated `{"operations":[...]}` via `inputFile`; `get_timeline`/`get_media` `outputFile` returns `file.path`. Public Host workspace data; no internal project JSON edits. Input ≤8 MiB, immutable during call; output parents exist/files new. - Real media/clip IDs/latest `expectedRevision`; missing state/conflict: reread/recompute. New-ID dependencies: next batch. - Time: `{seconds}` OR `{frame}`; visuals before subtitles/titles. - Omitted `timelineId`: `main`, not UI tab. Multiple timelines: `list_timelines`, use target fps/canvas. | Operation semantics | Independent example | | --- | --- | | Place media. Video/audio sourceRange: half-open source seconds, rounded to source frames, within duration; video needs fps, audio falls back to timeline fps. Exclusive with durationSeconds. at places; omitted appends in array order. No range: start at source beginning; images default 5s, others source duration. Omitted tracks: compatible video/audio tracks. newTrack excludes trackId/magnetic. Returns created clips. | `{"op":"add_clips","clips":[{"mediaId":"media_1","sourceRange":{"startSeconds":10,"endSeconds":18},"at":{"seconds":0}},{"mediaId":"media_1","sourceRange":{"startSeconds":40,"endSeconds":46}}]}` | | Title on compatible text track (create if needed); default 150 timeline frames. Returns created title. | `{"op":"add_title","text":"Opening","at":{"seconds":0},"durationSeconds":4}` | | One subtitle/cue; absolute timeline seconds, start < end; hostClipId: existing clip ID. Returns created subtitles. | `{"op":"add_subtitles","cues":[{"startSeconds":0,"endSeconds":2,"text":"Hello"}]}` | | Saved transcripts → selected clips with trims/speed; no ASR/translation. Source: mediaId, clipIds, or timeline range. Returns created subtitles; skips missing/already-existing transcripts. | `{"op":"subtitles_from_transcript","source":{"clipIds":["c1"]}}` | | Trim start/end via delta (removed) OR toDuration (result); opposite edge fixed. Valid source bounds, including reverse. Subtitle cues/words and transform/volume keyframes follow retained segment. Cutting inside nonlinear curves rejects batch: operation_conflict (nonlinear_keyframe_boundary); cut at keyframe or clear curve first. Returns affected ID. | `{"op":"trim","clipId":"c1","side":"end","toDuration":{"seconds":3}}` | | Earliest selected clip → to; preserve offsets; target track accepts all items. Returns affected IDs. | `{"op":"move","clipIds":["c1","c2"],"to":{"seconds":3}}` | | IDs or half-open timeline range. lift: gaps remain; ripple: close gaps on same track only. Returns deleted/affected IDs. | `{"op":"delete","target":{"clipIds":["c1"]},"mode":"lift"}` | | Gain: dB; fades/automation: clip-relative seconds. clearKeyframes clears volume automation. Returns affected IDs. | `{"op":"set_volume","clipIds":["c1"],"gainDb":-6,"fadeInSeconds":0.5,"fadeOutSeconds":0.5}` | Optional [templates](references/subtitle-templates.md): view catalog/contact sheet with image reader. Custom typography/colors/backgrounds/strokes/placement: supported `design.style`, no preset IDs. Text/timing edits keep design. `design.animationPresetId` + `style` overrides; style alone retains animation. [Design fields](references/edit-timeline/subtitle-design.schema.json); operation schemas for simple keyframes/transitions, [Advanced editing](capabilities/advanced-timeline-editing.md) for cross-track/multiple-timeline/complex edits. ### Media Analysis and Subtitles Import first; choose by question; parallel independent work; stop at sufficient evidence. Talking heads: usually transcription/frames; AI: shot detection as needed. 1. Transcribe: reuse `get_media` transcripts; skip speechless media. Before batch `transcribe_media`: original `durationSeconds` from `get_media(operation:"list")`: ≤3600s/60min; trims cannot bypass. Report oversized file/limit. Await background notifications, do independent work, no polling. Only when word-level edits need missing timestamps: `granularity:"word"`; never infer from segments. 2. Frames: timestamped contact sheets for composition/style/shot distribution; individual frames/denser uncertain intervals, covering entrances/transitions/action peaks/exits. Source: `inspect(mediaId:...)`. 3. Shots: if cut points still needed, available PySceneDetect; retain source timestamps. 4. Video understanding: default off (hallucinations); only if other methods cannot locate segments. Accessible URL/path + specific question + timestamps; verify against originals. Locate by text/source timestamps. Completed transcript: `get_media(operation:"context",mediaId:"",level:"dense",modality:"transcript")`. `subtitles_from_transcript` maps placed clips' source times/trims/speed. Translations: translate + `add_subtitles`, verified timeline seconds. [Transcription](capabilities/transcription.md#native-transcription): errors/cache; other sections: speech-boundary audition/timing/recovery/explicit CLI. **Keyframes**: compare reference/output, before/after, neighboring exits/entrances at matched action/narrative beats for composition/identity/color/continuity; investigate uncertainty, revise. ### Motion Graphics The project-owned Hyperframes-compatible local engine does not include HeyGen HyperFrames source code or call HeyGen-hosted rendering/voice/avatar/other paid services; its name does not imply partnership, endorsement, or co-development. Planned MG: [Native MG](capabilities/native-motion-graphics.md) templates/builder/bundle contract; effects may need `hyperframes-core`, `hyperframes-animation`, or rules. Follow the existing plan; don't restart `hyperframes`, intent interview, or `general-video`. `import_media`: self-contained bundle, `source.kind: "mg"`, absolute `source.directoryPath`; no prerender. Composite/verify/export in Editor. ### Verification and Delivery QA: `get_timeline` arrangement, batch `inspect` visuals (not audio); sound at asset preparation/edit joins. Judge seen images; tool failure: unverified, not defective. `export_project`: await background notifications, no polling. Deliver absolute `outputPath` link; no post-export frames/transcoding/loudness processing. Asked progress: refresh `export_project(operation:"wait")` or `get_status(include:["jobs"])`; no stale inference/new export. UI jobs: current status, no promised auto-notification. Committed `edit_timeline` + new `revision`: **Open edited project** link: exact `project.resourceUri` returned for it by `manage_projects`/`editor_update_project`. `manus-resource://`, not `manus-widget://`/export path. `dryRun`: `plan`, no save/link. Reuse URI; never invent/retrieve solely for link/reopen for delivery. Missing URI: silently omit. ## Verify During Production Check assets/composites: first/representative segment content/sound/visuals/pacing/continuity, significant edits/doubts. Reuse unaffected checks. Match people/clothes/products/settings to references/designs. Fix consistency via designs/reference mappings (images when words fail), presentation via shots/actions, divergence via intent. Check cuts add information; action/camera motion follows the plan. Watch full actions at normal speed; sequential frames leave perceived speed unverified. Fix/regenerate materially missing action; pretty stills cannot pass; intentional locked shots valid.
